semantics.baseline: Identity-eligible R2+A1 candidates operationally included unless a frozen human judgment is INVALID or UNCERTAIN.
semantics.cross_route_intersection: Seven residual (R2+A2 intersect R3+A1) minus R2+A1 pairs; individually confirmed by researcher after viewing model-presented frozen OpenAlex evidence in chat; NOT blind independent adjudication.
semantics.duplicates: Unique OpenAlex Work IDs; possible same-content works are NOT deduplicated.
semantics.identity: All 17 original overaggregated retrieval targets are held.
semantics.limits: R2+A1 and marginal operational inclusion are not complete human verification. R4 title-only retrieval is not included. Counts are not corrected for estimated false-positive rates.
semantics.marginal_routes: Reuse frozen A2 and Alias final dispositions.
semantics.unit: Unique Project W x OpenAlex Work pair.
